parts.name: Engine block
parts.function: Holds the cylinders and supports the crankshaft; the main structure of the engine.
parts.location: Centre of the engine, below the cylinder head.

parts.name: Cylinder head
parts.function: Closes the top of the cylinders and carries the valves, camshafts and ports.
parts.location: On top of the engine block.

parts.name: Head gasket
parts.function: Seals combustion gas, oil and coolant passages between the block and the head.
parts.location: Between the engine block and the cylinder head.
symptoms: Coolant loss without a visible leak

parts.name: Pistons and rings
parts.function: Receive combustion pressure and pass it to the crankshaft through the connecting rods.
parts.location: Inside the cylinders.

parts.name: Crankshaft
parts.function: Turns the pistons' up-and-down movement into rotation.
parts.location: Bottom of the engine block, above the sump.
symptoms: Knocking from the bottom of the engine

parts.name: Camshafts
parts.function: Open the valves at the right moment through lobes on a rotating shaft.
parts.location: In the cylinder head.

parts.name: Timing chain or belt
parts.function: Keeps the camshafts in step with the crankshaft.
parts.location: At one end of the engine, behind a cover.
symptoms: Engine will not start after a failure
parts.ifFails: Camshafts lose step with the crankshaft and the engine stops. On many engines valves and pistons then collide.

lifecycle.normal: Holds crankshaft and camshafts in step.
lifecycle.wear: A belt ages and cracks; a chain and its guides wear and rattle at start-up.
lifecycle.failure: It jumps or breaks and the engine stops, often with internal damage.

parts.name: Flywheel
parts.function: Smooths the engine's rotation and gives the clutch or converter its mounting face.
parts.location: Between the engine and the gearbox.

parts.name: Turbocharger
parts.function: Uses exhaust energy to compress the intake air so the engine can burn more fuel.
parts.location: On the exhaust manifold, usually at the side or rear of the engine.
parts.ifFails: Boost is lost, so the engine makes much less power. Worn seals can also pass oil into the intake or exhaust.

lifecycle.normal: Shaft spins freely on its oil film and seals hold.
lifecycle.wear: Bearing play and seal wear: whistle, some oil mist.
lifecycle.failure: Loss of boost, heavy oil consumption, or wheel contact with the housing.

parts.name: Intercooler
parts.function: Cools the compressed intake air before it enters the engine.
parts.location: In the intake path between turbocharger and engine, often behind the front bumper.
parts.ifFails: A leak lets boost escape: less power and a hissing sound under load.

parts.name: Spark plugs
parts.function: Ignite the air-fuel mixture in each cylinder.
parts.location: Screwed into the cylinder head, one per cylinder.
parts.ifFails: The mixture in that cylinder does not ignite reliably: misfire, rough idle, unburned fuel in the exhaust.

lifecycle.normal: Clean electrodes and a strong spark.
lifecycle.wear: Electrodes erode and the gap grows; occasional misfire.

parts.name: Ignition coils
parts.function: Step battery voltage up to the level needed to fire the spark plugs.
parts.location: On top of the engine, usually one above each spark plug.
parts.ifFails: One cylinder loses its spark and misfires.

parts.name: Glow plugs
parts.function: Heat the combustion chambers so a cold diesel engine starts cleanly.
parts.location: Screwed into the cylinder head, one per cylinder.
symptoms: White smoke after a cold start
parts.ifFails: Cold starts become difficult and smoky; a warm engine is unaffected.

parts.name: Oil pump
parts.function: Circulates engine oil to the bearings and other moving parts.
parts.location: Low in the engine, in or near the sump.
parts.ifFails: Oil pressure is lost. Bearings and camshafts run without their oil film and are damaged within moments; the engine must be stopped at once.

parts.name: Engine mounts
parts.function: Hold the engine in the body and isolate its vibration.
parts.location: Between the engine or gearbox and the body structure.

parts.name: Fuel pump
parts.function: Sends fuel from the tank to the engine.
parts.location: Usually inside the fuel tank.
symptoms: Engine cranks but will not start
parts.ifFails: No fuel reaches the engine. It cranks but will not run, or cuts out under load.

parts.name: High-pressure fuel pump
parts.function: Raises fuel to injection pressure for the common rail.
parts.location: On the engine, driven by the engine itself.
parts.ifFails: Injection pressure is lost. The engine will not start or goes into reduced power; debris can travel downstream to the injectors.

parts.name: Fuel injectors
parts.function: Meter and spray fuel into the intake ports or directly into the cylinders.
parts.location: In the cylinder head or intake manifold, one per cylinder.
parts.ifFails: A cylinder gets too little or too much fuel: misfire, rough running, smoke, diluted oil.

parts.name: Throttle body
parts.function: Regulates the air entering the engine.
parts.location: In the intake tract before the intake manifold.

parts.name: Fuel tank
parts.function: Stores the fuel and houses the pump and level sender.
parts.location: Under the rear seat or boot floor.

parts.name: Exhaust manifold
parts.function: Collects exhaust gas from the cylinders.
parts.location: Bolted to the cylinder head on the exhaust side.

parts.name: Catalytic converter
parts.function: Converts harmful exhaust gases into less harmful ones.
parts.location: In the exhaust, close to the engine.

parts.name: Diesel particulate filter
parts.function: Traps soot from the exhaust and burns it off during regeneration.
parts.location: In the exhaust, close to the engine.
parts.ifFails: A blocked filter restricts the exhaust: power falls and regeneration warnings appear.

lifecycle.normal: Collects soot and burns it off during regeneration.
lifecycle.wear: Soot and ash build up when regenerations are interrupted.
lifecycle.failure: Blocked: high back-pressure, reduced power, warning.

parts.name: EGR valve
parts.function: Feeds a measured amount of exhaust gas back into the intake to lower combustion temperature.
parts.location: Between the exhaust and intake sides of the engine.
parts.ifFails: Stuck open it upsets idle and smokes; stuck closed, combustion temperature and emissions rise.

parts.name: AdBlue (SCR) system
parts.function: Injects urea solution into the exhaust to reduce nitrogen oxides. Fitted to many, not all, modern diesels.
parts.location: Tank near the fuel tank or boot; injector in the exhaust.

parts.name: Rear silencer
parts.function: Reduces exhaust noise.
parts.location: At the rear of the exhaust system.

parts.name: Radiator
parts.function: Releases heat from the coolant to the air.
parts.location: At the front of the vehicle behind the grille.
parts.ifFails: Heat is no longer shed to the air, or coolant is lost. Engine temperature rises under load.

parts.name: Coolant pump
parts.function: Circulates coolant through the engine and radiator.
parts.location: On the engine, driven by a belt, the timing drive or an electric motor.
parts.ifFails: Coolant stops circulating, so heat stays in the engine. Temperature climbs quickly and the engine has to be shut down before the head and gasket are damaged.

lifecycle.wear: Seal weeps and the bearing becomes noisy.
lifecycle.failure: Leak or seized bearing; circulation stops.

parts.name: Thermostat
parts.function: Keeps coolant in the engine until it is warm, then lets it reach the radiator.
parts.location: In a housing where coolant leaves or enters the engine.
parts.ifFails: Stuck closed, coolant never reaches the radiator and the engine overheats. Stuck open, the engine runs cool, warms slowly and uses more fuel.

parts.name: Cooling fan
parts.function: Draws air through the radiator when the vehicle is slow or stationary.
parts.location: Behind the radiator.

parts.name: Coolant expansion tank
parts.function: Takes up the coolant's expansion and shows the level.
parts.location: In the engine bay or front compartment.

parts.name: Battery cooling loop
parts.function: Keeps the high-voltage battery in its working temperature range.
parts.location: Around the battery pack, with its own pump and heat exchanger.
parts.ifFails: The battery drifts out of its temperature range, so charging and power are limited.

parts.name: Inverter coolant pump
parts.function: Circulates coolant through the inverter and power electronics.
parts.location: In the front compartment on the power-electronics cooling circuit.
parts.ifFails: Power electronics lose their cooling and the drive system limits power or shuts down.

parts.name: Oil filter
parts.function: Removes particles from the engine oil.
parts.location: On the engine, as a screw-on canister or a cartridge in a housing.
symptoms: Changed with the oil; a blocked filter opens its bypass
parts.ifFails: A blocked filter opens its bypass, so unfiltered oil circulates and wear increases.

lifecycle.failure: Bypass opens and unfiltered oil circulates.

parts.name: Air filter
parts.function: Removes dust from the air entering the engine.
parts.location: In the air box in the engine bay.

lifecycle.failure: Restricts the engine or, if damaged, lets dust through.

parts.name: Fuel filter
parts.function: Removes particles, and on diesels water, from the fuel.
parts.location: In the fuel line; on some petrol cars built into the tank module.

parts.name: Cabin air filter
parts.function: Cleans the air entering the passenger compartment.
parts.location: Behind the glovebox or under the windscreen scuttle.

parts.name: Auxiliary drive belt
parts.function: Drives ancillaries such as the alternator and air-conditioning compressor from the crankshaft.
parts.location: At the end of the engine, around several pulleys.
parts.ifFails: Everything it drives stops: the alternator no longer charges, and on some engines the coolant pump and steering assistance stop too.

lifecycle.failure: Snaps or comes off; everything it drives stops.

parts.name: Belt tensioner
parts.function: Keeps the auxiliary belt at the correct tension.
parts.location: On the front of the engine against the auxiliary belt.

parts.name: Gearbox
parts.function: Provides the gear ratios between the engine and the driven wheels.
parts.location: Bolted to the engine.
parts.ifFails: Drive is interrupted or limited to some gears.

parts.name: Clutch
parts.function: Connects and disconnects the engine from the gearbox. Manual and dual-clutch versions only.
parts.location: Between the engine and the gearbox.
parts.ifFails: Slipping, it no longer passes full engine torque; not releasing, gears cannot be selected.

lifecycle.normal: Bites cleanly and passes full torque.
lifecycle.wear: Bite point moves and the plate starts to slip under load in high gears.
lifecycle.failure: It slips constantly or will not release.

parts.name: Torque converter
parts.function: Fluid coupling between engine and gearbox. Conventional automatic versions only.
parts.location: Between the engine and the automatic gearbox.

parts.name: Reduction gearbox
parts.function: Single fixed ratio that lowers motor speed to wheel speed.
parts.location: In the drive unit with the traction motor.

parts.name: Differential
parts.function: Lets the left and right driven wheels turn at different speeds.
parts.location: In the gearbox or drive unit, or in a separate axle housing.

parts.name: Driveshafts
parts.function: Carry drive to the wheels.
parts.location: Between the differential and each driven wheel.
parts.ifFails: Drive to that wheel is lost.

parts.name: CV joints and boots
parts.function: Let the driveshafts work at an angle while the wheels steer and move with the suspension.
parts.location: At each end of the driveshafts.
symptoms: Grease thrown around the wheel arch
parts.ifFails: A worn joint clicks and vibrates; if it breaks, drive to that wheel is lost.

lifecycle.normal: Boot intact, joint packed with clean grease.
lifecycle.wear: Boot splits; grease is lost and dirt gets in.
lifecycle.failure: Clicking on turns, vibration, eventually loss of drive.

parts.name: High-voltage battery
parts.function: Stores the energy for electric drive.
parts.location: Under the floor, under the rear seat or in the boot.
parts.ifFails: Electric drive is reduced or unavailable.

lifecycle.normal: Delivers its rated range and power.
lifecycle.wear: Capacity slowly declines with age and use.
lifecycle.failure: Range and power fall far enough to trigger warnings.

parts.name: Traction motor
parts.function: Turns electrical energy into drive and recovers energy when slowing.
parts.location: In the drive unit, or between engine and gearbox on hybrids.
parts.ifFails: Electric drive is lost.

parts.name: Inverter
parts.function: Converts battery direct current into the alternating current the motor needs, and back when recovering energy.
parts.location: In the front compartment or on the drive unit.
parts.ifFails: The motor receives no usable current: electric drive is lost.

parts.name: DC/DC converter
parts.function: Steps high voltage down to charge the 12-volt system, in place of an alternator.
parts.location: With the power electronics.
parts.ifFails: The 12-volt battery is no longer charged from the high-voltage battery and eventually runs flat.

parts.name: Onboard charger
parts.function: Converts mains alternating current into direct current to charge the battery.
parts.location: Near the charge port or with the power electronics.
parts.ifFails: The car cannot charge from an AC socket; DC fast charging, where fitted, bypasses it.

parts.name: Charge port
parts.function: Connects the vehicle to a charging cable.
parts.location: Behind a flap on the wing or rear quarter.
symptoms: Cable will not lock or release

parts.name: Front brake discs
parts.function: Rotate with the front wheels; the pads clamp them to slow the vehicle.
parts.location: Behind each front wheel.

lifecycle.wear: Scoring, a lip at the edge, or thickness variation felt as vibration.
lifecycle.failure: Below its limit the disc overheats, cracks or cannot be braked on evenly.

parts.name: Rear brake discs
parts.function: Rotate with the rear wheels; the pads clamp them to slow the vehicle. Some small cars use rear drums instead.
parts.location: Behind each rear wheel.

parts.name: Front brake pads
parts.function: Friction material pressed against the front discs.
parts.location: In the front calipers.

lifecycle.normal: Friction material is thick and brakes evenly.
lifecycle.wear: Material thins; a wear indicator may squeal or light a warning.
lifecycle.failure: Backing plate meets the disc: grinding, poor braking, disc damage.

parts.name: Rear brake pads
parts.function: Friction material pressed against the rear discs.
parts.location: In the rear calipers.

lifecycle.normal: Friction material is thick and brakes evenly.
lifecycle.wear: Material thins; a wear indicator may squeal or light a warning.
lifecycle.failure: Backing plate meets the disc: grinding, poor braking, disc damage.

parts.name: Brake calipers
parts.function: Use hydraulic pressure to clamp the pads onto the discs.
parts.location: Over each brake disc.

parts.name: Brake lines and hoses
parts.function: Carry hydraulic pressure from the master cylinder to each brake.
parts.location: Along the underbody, with flexible hoses at each wheel.
parts.ifFails: Fluid and pressure are lost in that circuit. The other circuit still brakes, with a longer pedal.

parts.name: ABS unit
parts.function: Modulates brake pressure to stop wheels locking and to run stability control.
parts.location: In the engine bay or front compartment, on the brake lines.
parts.ifFails: Anti-lock and stability functions switch off. Ordinary braking remains.

parts.name: Front dampers
parts.function: Control the movement of the front springs.
parts.location: At each front wheel, usually inside the coil spring.

lifecycle.normal: Settles the body after one movement.
lifecycle.wear: Misting of oil, more bounce, longer braking on rough roads.
lifecycle.failure: Leaking and no longer controlling the spring.

parts.name: Rear dampers
parts.function: Control the movement of the rear springs.
parts.location: At each rear wheel.

parts.name: Coil springs
parts.function: Carry the vehicle's weight and absorb bumps.
parts.location: At each wheel.

parts.name: Control arms
parts.function: Locate the wheel and let it move up and down.
parts.location: Between the hub carrier and the body or subframe.

parts.name: Suspension bushings
parts.function: Rubber mountings that let suspension arms pivot while isolating vibration.
parts.location: At the inner ends of the suspension arms and links.

parts.name: Anti-roll bar and links
parts.function: Links left and right suspension to reduce body roll.
parts.location: Across the chassis at the front, rear or both.

parts.name: Steering rack
parts.function: Turns steering wheel rotation into sideways movement of the front wheels.
parts.location: Across the front of the vehicle, low down.

parts.name: Tie rods and ends
parts.function: Join the steering rack to each front wheel.
parts.location: At each end of the steering rack.

parts.name: Power steering assistance
parts.function: Adds assistance to the driver's steering effort; electric on most current cars.
parts.location: On the steering column or the rack.
parts.ifFails: Assistance is lost. The steering still works but is heavy.

parts.name: Wheel bearings
parts.function: Let each wheel turn freely while carrying the vehicle's weight.
parts.location: In the hub at each wheel.
symptoms: Droning that changes with speed or cornering
parts.ifFails: Noise and play grow at that wheel; left long enough, the wheel is no longer held true.

lifecycle.wear: A drone that changes with speed and cornering.
lifecycle.failure: Roughness and play; the wheel is no longer held true.

parts.name: 12-volt battery
parts.function: Powers the low-voltage electrical system and, on engine cars, the starter.
parts.location: In the engine bay, boot or under a seat.
parts.ifFails: There is not enough energy to start or to wake the control units, even on an electric car.

lifecycle.wear: Capacity fades; slow cranking after standing or in cold weather.
lifecycle.failure: Cannot start the car or support the control units.

parts.name: Alternator
parts.function: Generates electricity from the running engine to charge the 12-volt battery.
parts.location: On the engine, driven by the auxiliary belt.
parts.ifFails: The 12-volt battery is no longer charged. The car runs on the battery until it is flat.

parts.name: Starter motor
parts.function: Turns the engine over to start it.
parts.location: On the gearbox bell housing, engaging the flywheel.
parts.ifFails: The engine cannot be cranked.

parts.name: Headlights
parts.function: Light the road ahead.
parts.location: At the front corners of the body.

parts.name: Wheel speed sensors
parts.function: Report each wheel's speed to the ABS and stability systems.
parts.location: At each wheel hub.
parts.ifFails: The ABS unit loses that wheel's speed, so anti-lock and stability functions switch off.

parts.name: Oxygen (lambda) sensors
parts.function: Measure oxygen in the exhaust so the engine controller can correct the mixture.
parts.location: In the exhaust, before and after the catalytic converter.

parts.name: Air mass sensor
parts.function: Measures the air entering the engine.
parts.location: In the intake duct after the air filter.
parts.ifFails: Air is mis-measured, so fuelling is wrong: hesitation and a warning light.

parts.name: Crankshaft position sensor
parts.function: Tells the engine controller the crankshaft's position and speed.
parts.location: On the engine block or bell housing, facing the crankshaft or flywheel.
parts.ifFails: The control unit no longer knows the crankshaft position: the engine cuts out or will not start.

parts.name: NOx sensors
parts.function: Measure nitrogen oxides in the exhaust for the emissions system.
parts.location: In the exhaust, near the SCR catalyst.

parts.name: Coolant temperature sensor
parts.function: Reports coolant temperature to the controller and the gauge.
parts.location: In a coolant passage or hose.

parts.name: Air-conditioning compressor
parts.function: Compresses the refrigerant; belt-driven on engine cars, electric on electrified ones.
parts.location: On the engine or in the front compartment.
symptoms: Noise when the air conditioning is on

parts.name: Air-conditioning condenser
parts.function: Releases the refrigerant's heat to the outside air.
parts.location: At the front, ahead of the radiator.

parts.name: Heater blower motor
parts.function: Pushes air through the heater and vents.
parts.location: Behind the dashboard, usually on the passenger side.

parts.name: Heater matrix
parts.function: Uses hot engine coolant to warm the cabin air.
parts.location: Behind the dashboard.

parts.name: Wiper blades
parts.function: Clear water from the windscreen.
parts.location: At the base of the windscreen, and on the rear window where fitted.

parts.name: Bonnet gas struts
parts.function: Hold the bonnet open. Not fitted to every model.
parts.location: At the sides of the engine bay.

parts.name: Connecting rods
parts.function: Join each piston to the crankshaft and turn its straight push into a turning force.
parts.location: Inside the engine, between the pistons and the crankshaft.
symptoms: Low oil pressure when bearings wear

parts.name: Valves
parts.function: Open to let the mixture in and the exhaust out, and seal the cylinder in between.
parts.location: In the cylinder head, above each cylinder.

parts.name: Engine control unit
parts.function: Reads the engine sensors and commands fuel, ignition and air.
parts.location: In the engine bay or behind the dashboard.
parts.ifFails: Fuel, ignition and air are no longer coordinated: the engine will not run.

parts.name: Intake manifold
parts.function: Shares the incoming air between the cylinders.
parts.location: Bolted to the cylinder head on the intake side.

parts.name: Supercharger
parts.function: An engine-driven compressor that forces extra air into the cylinders.
parts.location: On or beside the engine, in the intake path, driven from the crankshaft.

parts.name: Fuel rail
parts.function: A pressurised pipe that feeds every injector with fuel at the same pressure.
parts.location: Along the cylinder head, joined to each injector.

parts.name: Oil sump
parts.function: Collects the oil that drains back and holds it for the pump.
parts.location: Bolted to the underside of the engine block.
symptoms: Oil leak at the gasket or plug

parts.name: High-voltage contactors
parts.function: Heavy relays that connect the battery to the rest of the high-voltage system, and isolate it when off or in a fault.
parts.location: Inside the battery pack or its junction box.
parts.ifFails: The battery cannot be connected, so the vehicle will not go ready.

parts.name: Power-split device
parts.function: A planetary gear set that blends the engine and two electric machines, giving a stepless ratio with no clutch or belt.
parts.location: In the hybrid transaxle, between the engine and the wheels.

parts.name: Transfer case
parts.function: Sends drive to both axles on all-wheel-drive versions.
parts.location: Behind or beside the gearbox.

parts.name: Brake master cylinder and booster
parts.function: Turns pedal force, with assistance, into hydraulic pressure for the brakes.
parts.location: On the bulkhead in front of the driver.
parts.ifFails: Hydraulic pressure cannot be built. Dual circuits mean some braking remains, with a long pedal.

parts.name: 48-volt starter-generator
parts.function: Restarts the engine, adds a little assistance and recovers energy when slowing. Present on mild-hybrid versions.
parts.location: On the engine, in the auxiliary belt drive or between engine and gearbox.
